facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's blog, the company's Solutions Team came to fruition towards the end of 2019, after the team realized its consultative approach with clients was driving real business outcomes.
facts.quote: Towards the end of 2019, our team came to the realization that the consultative approach we had been taking with our clients was driving real business outcomes

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog post profiling Solutions Manager Meredith Henschel was published on 17 August 2020.
According to the profile, Meredith Henschel had been working in the programmatic industry for two years at the time the post was written.
facts.quote: When I started out in the programmatic industry two years ago
